decisions.reason: High sunk investment, a dedicated page and quantified public launch, and centrality to the Black Edition make management persist despite any disappointing results.
Its own page since launch, quantified launch, and centrality to seamless shower drainage create strong public commitment and sunk costs, so the firm keeps it.

Although newer and following a discontinued pump-assisted product, its dedicated page and the firm's prior investment in pump-drain technology lead to persistence while weak results are attributed to temporary causes.
